name: Marisol
source:
The mayor of Fortune Island. She considers all the people on the island to be her children and refers to them as such. Her job doesn't allow for much spare time, so she's not really a potential interviewee. All interviews with her must be scheduled in advance.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=23120]Lemma Soft WIP Thread[/url]]
